observed: Cream walls, red-brown pilasters, floor bands and Taslim Olawale Elias Library signage. Two narrow cream-framed louver strips extend nearly the full facade height near its ends.
Two stacked glass-block panels sit to the photo-right of the entrance; their area is distinct from the neighboring ordinary window bays.
estimated: The existing hip-roof shape is illustrative and is not confirmed by the ground-level view.
Facade assignment, heights, module spacing and unseen elevations are estimates. Footprint and routing remain those of the current published release.
The existing approximate roof ridge layout is retained as SolidCraft panels and raised to sit above the model wall height; it is not a measured roof.
Front louver-strip widths, spacing and blade pitch are estimated from the photograph; they are not repeated on unobserved elevations.
Glass-block panel sizes, adjacent bay gaps and lettering stand-off remain estimates; the special panels are confined to the observed front.
